fullDescription: Numbered, Swiss / International-Typographic FAQ rendered as a near-monochrome type specimen: an oversized Inter headline ('Frequently asked, answered.') with red comma + period, a tiny 'Support / Reference' eyebrow column, a full-bleed inverted ink feature rule, and a numbered accordion list under a heavy ink top rule where a Swiss plus glyph (two crossing hairlines) collapses to a single red rule on the one pre-opened row, closed by a black 'Still curious' CTA band, all built from 1px hairlines on a 12-column grid with no cards or shadows.

structured.summary: A numbered, Swiss / International-Typographic FAQ page rendered as a type specimen. A near-invisible sticky paper nav (a single red square mark + 'Specimen' wordmark, Index / Questions / Contact links, a hairline 'Start free' pill) sits over a full-bleed 12-column hero where a tiny 'SUPPORT / Reference' eyebrow column sits left of an oversized Inter headline 'Frequently asked, answered.' with the comma and period punched in red. A full-bleed inverted ink band runs a row of micro-tracked uppercase feature labels. The FAQ is a numbered list under a single heavy 1.5px ink top rule: each row is a 12-column grid (a tabular '01' number, the question, a Swiss plus glyph built from two hairlines), one row ships pre-opened where the number, plus and active states tint red and the plus collapses to a single horizontal rule. A full-bleed black 'Still curious' CTA band with a red primary pill + outline secondary pill, and a hairline paper footer with a centered max-width grid, close the page.

style.description: Strict Swiss / International Typographic Style executed as a type specimen, almost monochrome. The whole page is paper #ffffff with near-black ink #0a0a0a text; structure is carried entirely by HAIRLINE rules (1px borders at rgba(10,10,10,0.14)) and a 12-column grid, never by fills or shadows. Exactly one accent, a signal red #ff3b30 (with a slightly darker #c81e16 for hover / active / small marks), used with extreme restraint: the square brand mark, the comma and period in the headline, the open-row number / plus / states, and the primary CTA pill. There are NO rounded cards, NO drop-shadows and NO gradients; the only inverted surfaces are two full-bleed ink #0a0a0a bands (the feature specimen rule and the CTA). Typography is the whole design: a single typeface, Inter, across weights 300-700, with negative letter-spacing on display type (-0.03em headlines), tabular-nums on all numbers, and wide 0.22em uppercase 'micro' eyebrows / labels. The signature is the numbered list and the plus/minus glyph built from two 1.5px crossing hairlines (a plus that loses its vertical stroke to become a single rule when open), plus a calm 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) grid-template-rows accordion. The result reads as a precise editorial reference sheet, not a typical SaaS FAQ.
style.prompt: Design in a strict Swiss / International Typographic Style as a near-monochrome type specimen. Background paper #ffffff; text near-black ink #0a0a0a. Carry ALL structure with hairline rules: 1px borders coloured rgba(10,10,10,0.14) (a 'hairline' class) and a 12-column grid, never with fills, cards, drop-shadows or gradients. Use exactly one accent, a signal red #ff3b30, plus a darker #c81e16 for hovers / active states / tiny marks, and spend it sparingly: a ~15px red square brand mark with a 2px radius, the comma and period punctuation inside the headline, the open FAQ row's number + plus glyph + active tint, and the primary CTA pill. The only inverted surfaces are two full-bleed ink #0a0a0a bands. Set everything in ONE typeface, Inter (weights 300/400/500/600/700), letter-spacing -0.011em on body; display headlines use tight tracking down to -0.03em and leading ~0.94; all numerals use tabular-nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums); eyebrows and labels are a 'micro' style at ~10.5px, 600 weight, UPPERCASE, very wide 0.22em tracking. No rounded corners except the tiny brand square and the pill buttons. Accordion motion is calm and editorial: a grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr expand over 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) with a 280ms opacity fade. The signature device is a plus glyph built from two crossing 1.5px ink hairlines (22px square) that, when the row opens, scales its vertical stroke to 0 (becoming a single horizontal rule) and tints red. Antialiased, scroll-behavior smooth.

layout_and_structure.description: A centered max-w-[1180px] container with px-6 / md:px-10 gutters runs through every section, separated by full-bleed hairline bottom borders. Order: a sticky paper nav, a 12-column hero (a 3-col eyebrow beside a 9-col headline + lead + tabular meta row), a full-bleed inverted ink 'specimen rule' of uppercase feature labels, the numbered FAQ list under a 1.5px ink top rule (a 3/9 split section header, then seven 12-column accordion rows), a full-bleed black 'Still curious' CTA band, and a hairline paper footer (a brand + tagline block beside Product / Company link columns over a baseline copyright row).

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header, paper #ffffff at ~85% opacity with backdrop-blur-md and a hairline (rgba(10,10,10,0.14)) bottom border. Inside, a max-w-[1180px] mx-auto px-6 md:px-10 flex row at h-[68px], items centered, space-between. Left: a brand lockup = a 15px red #ff3b30 square with a 2px radius nudged down 1px, next to a 16px Inter 600 'Specimen' wordmark with tight tracking. Center (hidden below md): nav links 'Index / Questions / Contact' at 13px Inter 500 in ink/60, hovering to full ink. Right: a 'Start free' pill = 13px Inter 500, a hairline border, rounded-full, px-4 py-[7px], inverting to ink #0a0a0a fill + paper text on hover.

A full-bleed section with a hairline bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1180px] px-6 md:px-10 12-column grid (gap-x-6) with pt-20 md:pt-28 pb-16 md:pb-20: a left col-span-3 holds a two-line 'micro' eyebrow (10.5px, 600, UPPERCASE, 0.22em tracking) reading 'Support' in ink/60 above '/ Reference' in the darker red #c81e16. The right col-span-9 holds an oversized Inter 600 h1 at clamp(2.6rem,7vw,5.6rem), leading 0.94, tracking -0.03em, reading 'Frequently / asked, answered.' with the comma after 'asked' and the final period both coloured signal red #ff3b30. Below, a max-w-[44ch] 16-17px ink/65 lead in the warm proactive-friend voice ('Everything about generating production-ready UI from a single prompt. Read top to bottom, or jump to a number. No tickets required.'). Then a tabular-nums meta row (12.5px, 500, ink/60) of three stats separated by thin vertical ink/15 dividers: '07 Questions', '2 min Read', 'Updated Jun 2026', with the numbers/values in bold ink.

prompts.partPt: Specimen rule (inverted Recursos e Diferenciais band)
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed inverted band: bg ink #0a0a0a, paper text, hairline bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1180px] px-6 md:px-10 grid that is 2 cols on mobile, 3 at sm, 5 at lg, of 'micro' 11.5px 500 UPPERCASE labels separated by paper/15 right borders: 'Prompt to UI', 'Infinite canvas', 'Component library' (hidden below sm), 'Coding-agent skill' and 'Ship faster' (hidden below lg). Each cell is py-3.5 with px-4 padding. This is a static type-specimen rule, no interaction.

prompts.partPt: Perguntas Frequentes (FAQ) section Menu do Topo
prompts.prompt: Inside the FAQ section (id=faq, scroll-mt-24, max-w-[1180px], px-6 md:px-10), a 12-column split header with pt-16 md:pt-24 pb-7 md:pb-10: a left col-span-3 'micro' 10.5px 600 UPPERCASE ink/60 eyebrow 'The questions' beside a right col-span-9 Inter 600 h2 at clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.1rem), tracking -0.02em, leading tight, reading 'Seven things people ask before their first design.'

The list opens with a single heavy border-t-[1.5px] ink #0a0a0a rule, then each entry is a .faq-item with a hairline bottom border. The question is a full-width left-aligned <button> with a 12-column grid (gap-x-6), items-baseline, py-7 md:py-8: a col-span-2 md:col-span-3 holds a tabular-nums number '02'-'07' at 15px md:17px, 600, in ink/60 (the .faq-num); a col-span-9 md:col-span-8 holds the question (.faq-q) at 20px md:26px, 500, tracking -0.02em, leading snug, in ink/80; a col-span-1 right-aligned cell holds the .faq-glyph. The glyph is a 22px square plus built from two absolutely-centered ink #0a0a0a bars (a 22px x 1.5px horizontal rule + a 1.5px x 22px vertical rule). On row hover the number, question and glyph all tint to the darker red #c81e16. The answer body (.faq-body) is collapsed via a CSS grid-template-rows: 0fr with opacity 0.

Ship the FIRST row ('What exactly does Superdesign do?', number 01) pre-opened with aria-expanded=true. When a .faq-item is .open: its number and the horizontal bar of the plus tint to the darker red #c81e16, the question goes full ink #0a0a0a, and the plus glyph's VERTICAL bar scales to scaleY(0) + fades (the plus becomes a single red horizontal rule / minus). The answer reveals by transitioning grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr over 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) with a 280ms opacity fade; the inner panel is a 12-column grid where the answer paragraph sits in md:col-start-4 md:col-span-8 (so it aligns under the question, indented past the number column), max-w-[58ch], 15.5-16px, 300 weight (light), leading relaxed, ink/65, pb-8. JS keeps the accordion single-open (opening one closes the rest).

prompts.partPt: Chamada Final para Ação band + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed CTA band: bg ink #0a0a0a, paper text, mt-20 md:mt-28. Inside a max-w-[1180px] px-6 md:px-10 12-column grid, items-center, py-16 md:py-20: a left col-span-7 holds a 'micro' 10.5px 600 UPPERCASE signal-red #ff3b30 eyebrow 'Still curious' above an Inter 600 h2 at clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3.4rem), leading 0.98, tracking -0.03em, 'The fastest answer is your first prompt.' with the period in signal red. The right col-span-5 (md:justify-end) holds a max-w-[280px] column of two rounded-full pills with space-between content + a trailing Iconify lucide arrow: a primary 'Open the canvas' pill (bg darker red #c81e16, paper text, 15px 700, lucide:arrow-up-right, hover opacity) and a secondary 'Browse the library' pill (paper/25 border, paper text, 15px 500, lucide:arrow-right, inverting to paper fill + ink text on hover). Then a hairline paper footer (id=footer): a max-w-[1180px] px-6 md:px-10 12-column grid (py-14) with a col-span-5 brand block (a 14px red square + 'Specimen' wordmark, a max-w-[34ch] 13.5px ink/65 tagline 'An AI product design agent. Prompt in, shippable UI out, on an infinite canvas.') and two link columns ('Product': Canvas / Library / Pricing and 'Company': About / FAQ / Contact, each a 'micro' 10px uppercase ink/60 label over 13.5px ink/60 500 links that hover to signal red). A hairline baseline row (py-6) carries a tabular '© 2026 Specimen, all rights reserved' on the left and a 'micro' 10px uppercase 'International / Typographic' tag on the right.

special_ui_components.prompt: Hairline-grid system: ALL structure (section dividers, the inverted-band cell separators, the meta-row dividers, the footer) is drawn with 1px rgba(10,10,10,0.14) hairlines + a 12-column grid, with zero cards, shadows or gradients

Swiss plus/minus glyph: a 22px square built from two absolutely-centered crossing 1.5px ink bars; on open the vertical bar scales to scaleY(0) + fades so the plus collapses to a single red horizontal rule (minus)

Numbered list pattern: tabular-nums '01'-'07' in a dedicated left grid column, with the open row's number / glyph / states tinting to the darker red #c81e16 and the answer indented to align under the question (md:col-start-4)
Calm editorial accordion: a CSS grid-template-rows 0fr -> 1fr expand over 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) + 280ms opacity fade, kept single-open by small JS (the layout also works statically)
Two full-bleed inverted ink #0a0a0a bands as the only non-paper surfaces: a uppercase micro-tracked feature 'specimen rule' and the 'Still curious' CTA band
Red-punctuation headlines: an otherwise monochrome Inter display headline whose comma and period are punched in signal red #ff3b30 as the single hero accent

structured.special_notes: Centered max-w-[1180px] container with px-6 / md:px-10 gutters throughout; every section divided by full-bleed hairline (rgba(10,10,10,0.14)) bottom borders. Palette is fixed and almost monochrome: paper #ffffff base, ink #0a0a0a text + the two inverted bands, exactly one accent signal red #ff3b30 with a darker #c81e16 for hover / active / small marks; no other colours, no shadows, no gradients, no rounded cards (only the tiny brand square and the pill buttons are rounded). ONE typeface only: Inter (weights 300-700) via Google Fonts; all numerals are tabular-nums; eyebrows/labels are a 'micro' style (~10.5px, 600, UPPERCASE, 0.22em tracking); display headlines track tight to -0.03em. Icons are Iconify lucide (lucide:arrow-up-right / lucide:arrow-right) on the CTA pills only. Exactly one FAQ row ships pre-opened. Responsive: the nav center links hide below md, the hero / FAQ / CTA 12-column grids collapse to a single column on mobile, the inverted feature band drops cells (5 -> 3 at sm -> 2 on mobile), and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is human and reassuring with zero em-dashes (warm proactive-friend voice: 'No tickets required.', 'Ping us and we will sort it together.', 'Real humans read every message, usually same day', 'no canned bot replies').
